name: ck_jghi_receipt_real_evaluation
target:
(operation_id='ProjectCostController_activateOperatingBaselinePackage' AND evaluation_hash IS NULL)
  OR (operation_id<>'ProjectCostController_activateOperatingBaselinePackage' AND evaluation_hash IS NOT NULL)

actual.definition: CHECK (operation_id::text = 'ProjectCostController_activateOperatingBaselinePackage'::text AND evaluation_hash IS NULL OR operation_id::text <> 'ProjectCostController_activateOperatingBaselinePackage'::text AND evaluation_hash IS NOT NULL)

CHECK (current_stage::text = ANY (ARRAY['assessment'::character varying, 'scope-confirmation'::character varying, 'commercial-closure'::character varying, 'contracting'::character varying, 'handover'::character varying, 'execution'::character varying, 'acceptance'::character varying, 'completed'::character varying, 'conditional-completed'::character varying, 'closed-lost'::character varying, 'closed-terminated'::character varying]::text[]))

name: project_handover_basis_item_item_type_check
target: (((item_type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['scope'::character varying, 'risk'::character varying, 'receivable'::character varying, 'cost'::character varying, 'responsibility'::character varying, 'attachment'::character varying, 'contract'::character varying])::text[])))

actual.definition: CHECK (item_type::text = ANY (ARRAY['scope'::character varying, 'risk'::character varying, 'receivable'::character varying, 'cost'::character varying, 'responsibility'::character varying, 'attachment'::character varying, 'contract'::character varying]::text[]))

name: archive_new_producer_check
target:
producer_version=0 OR (producer_version=1
    AND source_payload_hash IS NOT NULL AND source_payload_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND archived_by IS NOT NULL
    AND source_qualification IS NOT NULL
    AND ((archive_anchor_stage IN ('completed','conditional-completed') AND archive_anchor_source_type='project-completion-record'
         AND ((source_stage_record_id IS NOT NULL AND source_qualification='verified-producer') OR source_qualification='legacy-unverified'))
      OR (archive_anchor_stage IN ('closed-lost','closed-terminated') AND archive_anchor_source_type='project'
         AND source_qualification='legacy-unverified')))

actual.definition: CHECK (producer_version = 0 OR producer_version = 1 AND source_payload_hash IS NOT NULL AND source_payload_hash::text ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text AND archived_by IS NOT NULL AND source_qualification IS NOT NULL AND ((archive_anchor_stage::text = ANY (ARRAY['completed'::character varying, 'conditional-completed'::character varying]::text[])) AND archive_anchor_source_type::text = 'project-completion-record'::text AND (source_stage_record_id IS NOT NULL AND source_qualification = 'verified-producer'::text OR source_qualification = 'legacy-unverified'::text) OR (archive_anchor_stage::text = ANY (ARRAY['closed-lost'::character varying, 'closed-terminated'::character varying]::text[])) AND archive_anchor_source_type::text = 'project'::text AND source_qualification = 'legacy-unverified'::text))

name: chk_r4g_restatement_verified
target:
producer_version=0 OR
    (producer_version=1 AND restatement_scope IS NOT NULL AND restatement_scope IN ('live','period') AND root_snapshot_id IS NOT NULL
     AND (restatement_scope='period')=(period_end_snapshot_id IS NOT NULL)
     AND causal_source_refs IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(causal_source_refs)='array'
     AND before_source_hash IS NOT NULL AND before_source_hash~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
     AND after_source_hash IS NOT NULL AND after_source_hash~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND restatement_batch_id IS NOT NULL)

actual.definition: CHECK (producer_version = 0 OR producer_version = 1 AND restatement_scope IS NOT NULL AND (restatement_scope::text = ANY (ARRAY['live'::character varying, 'period'::character varying]::text[])) AND root_snapshot_id IS NOT NULL AND (restatement_scope::text = 'period'::text) = (period_end_snapshot_id IS NOT NULL) AND causal_source_refs IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(causal_source_refs) = 'array'::text AND before_source_hash IS NOT NULL AND before_source_hash::text ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text AND after_source_hash IS NOT NULL AND after_source_hash::text ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text AND restatement_batch_id IS NOT NULL)

name: ck_jghi_dmer_v1
target:
producer_version=0 OR (producer_version=1 AND evidence_id IS NOT NULL
  AND tax_pending_knowledge IS NOT NULL AND tax_pending_knowledge IN ('known','unknown')
  AND ((tax_pending_knowledge='known' AND tax_impact_pending_amount IS NOT NULL)
    OR (tax_pending_knowledge='unknown' AND tax_impact_pending_amount IS NULL)))

actual.definition: CHECK (producer_version = 0 OR producer_version = 1 AND evidence_id IS NOT NULL AND tax_pending_knowledge IS NOT NULL AND (tax_pending_knowledge::text = ANY (ARRAY['known'::character varying, 'unknown'::character varying]::text[])) AND (tax_pending_knowledge::text = 'known'::text AND tax_impact_pending_amount IS NOT NULL OR tax_pending_knowledge::text = 'unknown'::text AND tax_impact_pending_amount IS NULL))

name: ck_jghi_binding_v1
target:
producer_version=0 OR
  (producer_version=1 AND evidence_id IS NOT NULL AND system_binding_action IS NOT NULL
   AND system_binding_action IN ('prompt','review','block') AND gate_stage_type IN ('first','second','final','retention')
   AND evaluation_hash IS NOT NULL AND evaluation_hash~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND current_summary_id IS NOT NULL
   AND tax_pending_knowledge IS NOT NULL AND tax_pending_knowledge IN ('known','unknown')
   AND ((tax_pending_knowledge='known' AND tax_impact_pending_amount IS NOT NULL)
     OR (tax_pending_knowledge='unknown' AND tax_impact_pending_amount IS NULL)))

actual.definition: CHECK (producer_version = 0 OR producer_version = 1 AND evidence_id IS NOT NULL AND system_binding_action IS NOT NULL AND (system_binding_action::text = ANY (ARRAY['prompt'::character varying, 'review'::character varying, 'block'::character varying]::text[])) AND (gate_stage_type::text = ANY (ARRAY['first'::character varying, 'second'::character varying, 'final'::character varying, 'retention'::character varying]::text[])) AND evaluation_hash IS NOT NULL AND evaluation_hash::text ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text AND current_summary_id IS NOT NULL AND tax_pending_knowledge IS NOT NULL AND (tax_pending_knowledge::text = ANY (ARRAY['known'::character varying, 'unknown'::character varying]::text[])) AND (tax_pending_knowledge::text = 'known'::text AND tax_impact_pending_amount IS NOT NULL OR tax_pending_knowledge::text = 'unknown'::text AND tax_impact_pending_amount IS NULL))

name: ck_jghi_gate_review_v1
target:
producer_version=0 OR
  (producer_version=1 AND evidence_id IS NOT NULL AND source_summary_snapshot_id IS NOT NULL
   AND source_hash IS NOT NULL AND source_hash~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
   AND evaluation_hash IS NOT NULL AND evaluation_hash~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
   AND policy_hash IS NOT NULL AND policy_hash~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
   AND evidence_hash IS NOT NULL AND evidence_hash~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
   AND review_action IS NOT NULL AND review_action IN ('acknowledge','tighten-review','tighten-block')
   AND review_payload IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(review_payload)='object' AND handled_by IS NOT NULL)

actual.definition: CHECK (producer_version = 0 OR producer_version = 1 AND evidence_id IS NOT NULL AND source_summary_snapshot_id IS NOT NULL AND source_hash IS NOT NULL AND source_hash::text ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text AND evaluation_hash IS NOT NULL AND evaluation_hash::text ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text AND policy_hash IS NOT NULL AND policy_hash::text ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text AND evidence_hash IS NOT NULL AND evidence_hash::text ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text AND review_action IS NOT NULL AND (review_action::text = ANY (ARRAY['acknowledge'::character varying, 'tighten-review'::character varying, 'tighten-block'::character varying]::text[])) AND review_payload IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(review_payload) = 'object'::text AND handled_by IS NOT NULL)

CHECK (target_type::text = ANY (ARRAY['SharedCostAllocationBasis'::character varying, 'SharedCostAllocationResult'::character varying, 'CostStageAttributionSnapshot'::character varying, 'AccountingTaxTreatmentSnapshot'::character varying]::text[]))

name: project_handover_participant_role_role_key_check
target: (((role_key)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['sales-owner'::character varying, 'business-admin'::character varying, 'technical-support'::character varying, 'execution-owner'::character varying, 'finance'::character varying])::text[])))

actual.definition: CHECK (role_key::text = ANY (ARRAY['sales-owner'::character varying, 'business-admin'::character varying, 'technical-support'::character varying, 'execution-owner'::character varying, 'finance'::character varying]::text[]))

name: acceptance_new_producer_check
target:
producer_version=0 OR (producer_version=1 AND source_stage_record_id IS NOT NULL
    AND source_payload_hash IS NOT NULL AND source_payload_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND confirmed_by IS NOT NULL AND confirmed_at IS NOT NULL
    AND acceptance_type IN ('stage-outcome','stage-acceptance','final-acceptance')
    AND acceptance_result IN ('accepted','conditional','rejected')
    AND (acceptance_result<>'conditional' OR (conditional_summary IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim(conditional_summary))>0)))

actual.definition: CHECK (producer_version = 0 OR producer_version = 1 AND source_stage_record_id IS NOT NULL AND source_payload_hash IS NOT NULL AND source_payload_hash::text ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text AND confirmed_by IS NOT NULL AND confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND (acceptance_type::text = ANY (ARRAY['stage-outcome'::character varying, 'stage-acceptance'::character varying, 'final-acceptance'::character varying]::text[])) AND (acceptance_result::text = ANY (ARRAY['accepted'::character varying, 'conditional'::character varying, 'rejected'::character varying]::text[])) AND (acceptance_result::text <> 'conditional'::text OR conditional_summary IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim(conditional_summary)) > 0))

name: commission_role_assignment_participant_check
target:
(weight_units=0 AND zero_weight_reason IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim(zero_weight_reason)) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000)
        OR (weight_units>0 AND zero_weight_reason IS NULL)

actual.definition: CHECK (weight_units = 0 AND zero_weight_reason IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim(zero_weight_reason)) >= 1 AND length(btrim(zero_weight_reason)) <= 1000 OR weight_units > 0 AND zero_weight_reason IS NULL)
CHECK ((recognition_role::text <> ALL (ARRAY['tax-support'::character varying, 'evidence-only'::character varying]::text[])) OR decision::text = 'exclude'::text)
